  let f : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := λ x =>
      fun a => if h : p a then x.val h else x₀ ⟨a, h.not⟩
  let g : ({ a // ¬p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } := λ y =>
      { val := λ a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h.not⟩,
        property := λ a, begin
          cases a; simp; split_ifs; try { rw h },
          exact h.elim

  let f_inv_g : f ∘ g = id := fun y =>
    funext $ λ a, by simp; split_ifs; try { rw h }; congr' 1
  let g_inv_f : g ∘ f = id := fun x =>
    funext $ λ a, by simp; split_ifs; try { rw h }; congr' 1
